icon.description: Optional Lucide icon name on a blora-timeline-item; renders an icon node instead of a plain dot

content-layout.description: Layout for custom child content: inline keeps time directly after event text; block makes content fill the timeline column (e.g. comment cards)

slots.default: Declarative <blora-timeline-item time title description variant icon> definitions; consumed into the official list tree. Items may also carry child content (e.g. a comment card), rendered in .blora-timeline__content.

classes.blora-timeline__dot: Node on the rail (plain dot or icon node).
classes.blora-timeline__dot--icon: Icon node variant holding a Lucide icon.
